dedupe_keys.name: ml based monthly water table depth anomalies over the seine river basin

description: The STARS4Water team deposits monthly water-table-depth anomaly maps for France's Seine basin from random-forest and LSTM models. The Zenodo page states a 0.11-degree CORDEX EUR-11 grid and 2004 to 2022 overall coverage. Four public NetCDFs distinguish training and test periods for the two algorithms, with file names showing tested 2004 to 2008 and trained 2010 to 2021 slices. The files are public under CC BY 4.0. A groundwater simulation could use the anomalies to compare regional temporal patterns, with the training and test splits kept separate. These are modelled deviations, not measured water-table depth or an absolute groundwater level. The page links a published methodological study but says a fuller output collection sits on an external server that was not checked here. The Zenodo files and their units, baseline definition and missing-value codes were not opened. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this four-file release.
name: ML-based Monthly Water Table Depth Anomalies over the Seine River Basin
